provenance.zipGeography: KFF 2026 ZIP-to-county records joined to Census 2020 county FIPS
provenance.method: Unweighted statistics over unique 2026 individual-market on-exchange Silver PlanIds; each CSR tier separate; in-network tier 1 only. Missing values excluded, zero retained. Medical uses combined medical/drug deductible when integrated, medical-only otherwise. OOP uses combined medical/drug in-network tier 1 MOOP fields, independently of deductible integration; separate OOP structures require review. ZIP unions count each plan once across counties; county results use the selected county.
